newsitem.title: BELGIUM: N.AMERICAN TURBODYNE TO TRADE ON EASDAQ JULY 30.
newsitem.headline: N.AMERICAN TURBODYNE TO TRADE ON EASDAQ JULY 30.

text.p: European small cap stock market EASDAQ said on Tuesday it had approved an application for admission to trading on EASDAQ of all ordinary shares of Turbodyne Technologies Inc.
Turbodyne is expected to start trading on EASDAQ under the symbol from July 30, 1997. Its shares are already listed in Toronto and on Nasdaq.
Turbodyne's Easdaq sponsors are Investmentbank Austria. Market making will also be provided by Bayerische Vereinsbank, Beeson Gregory and Herzog Heine Geduld International.
Turbodyne develops and manufactures high-technology anti-pollution and performance-improvement devices for automotive, marine and industrial applications.
